title: Soybean crush margins widen in the US Midwest
content: Board crush margins improved as soybean meal demand from poultry integrators outpaced bean prices; plants in Iowa and Illinois are running near capacity.

title: Brazil soybean harvest pace ahead of five-year average
content: Favourable weather in Mato Grosso accelerated harvest; export line-ups at Santos and Paranaguá are filling for March shipment.

title: Argentina crush volumes recover after drought year
content: Higher farmer selling and an improved soy crop lift Rosario crush rates back toward normal utilisation.

title: Canola supply tightens on lower Canadian acreage
content: Reduced planted area on the Prairies and dry pockets in Saskatchewan point to a smaller canola crop and firmer basis at crushers.

title: Sunflower oil discount to palm narrows
content: Black Sea sunflower oil premiums firmed as Ukrainian crush slowed; buyers in India switched part of their book to palm.

title: Corn yields trend above USDA estimate in Illinois
content: Early combine reports show strong ear counts; basis at river terminals softened on heavy farmer movement.

title: Wheat protein premiums rise on hard red winter quality
content: Lower protein across Kansas pushes millers to pay up for 12%+ HRW; spreads to soft wheat widened.

title: Black Sea wheat exports set monthly record
content: Russian FOB offers undercut EU origins, winning Egyptian and Algerian tenders; freight rates held steady.

title: Sorghum demand from China lifts Texas Gulf basis
content: Renewed Chinese purchases of US sorghum tightened Gulf supplies ahead of the new crop.

title: Rice prices ease as India relaxes export curbs
content: Removal of minimum export prices on non-basmati rice weighed on Thai and Vietnamese quotes.

title: Barley malting premiums steady in Europe
content: Brewers covered Q3 needs early; weather in France and Germany remains supportive for quality.

title: Ethanol margins improve on lower corn costs
content: Plant margins turned positive as corn basis weakened and gasoline blending demand stayed seasonally firm.

title: Renewable diesel capacity additions pressure soybean oil spreads
content: New RD plants on the US Gulf Coast lifted feedstock demand, but credit values softened, compressing bean oil premiums.

title: Sustainable aviation fuel mandates drive lipid demand outlook
content: EU SAF blending requirements point to incremental demand for used cooking oil and tallow through the decade.

title: Brazil raises ethanol blend in gasoline
content: The higher mandatory blend supports domestic corn ethanol expansion in Mato Grosso.

title: Plant-based protein demand shifts toward pea and fava
content: Formulators favour pea and fava isolates for texture; soy protein still leads on cost per gram of protein.

title: Probiotic ingredient sales grow in Asia-Pacific
content: Digestive-health positioning drove double-digit growth in functional beverages across Japan and Korea.

title: Sugar reduction remains the top reformulation driver
content: Beverage makers are pairing stevia with allulose to close the taste gap versus full-sugar formulas.

title: Flavour trends: citrus and botanicals lead new launches
content: Yuzu, bergamot and elderflower appear in a growing share of global beverage launches.

title: Pet food premiumisation lifts specialty protein demand
content: Fresh and freeze-dried formats push demand for novel animal and insect proteins.

title: Soybean meal inclusion rises in European feed rations
content: Cheaper meal relative to wheat and rapeseed meal raised inclusion rates for swine and poultry.

title: Amino acid prices soften on new Chinese capacity
content: Lysine and threonine offers fell as additional fermentation capacity came online.

title: Aquafeed demand grows with salmon output
content: Norwegian and Chilean harvest growth supports demand for high-protein feed ingredients.

title: Mississippi River draft restrictions return
content: Low water at Memphis gauge forced barge draft reductions, lifting freight costs for Gulf-bound grain.

title: Panama Canal transit slots improve after rainy season
content: Restored draft and daily slots reduced wait times for grain vessels bound for Asia.

title: Container rates ease for specialty grain exports
content: Lower trans-Pacific box rates benefit identity-preserved soybean and pulse shipments.

title: Rail car availability tightens in Canadian Prairies
content: Strong canola and wheat movement outpaced hopper car supply; basis widened at inland elevators.

title: El Niño transition raises South American weather risk
content: Forecast shift toward La Niña conditions increases dryness risk for southern Brazil and Argentina this season.

title: US Corn Belt heat dome forecast for pollination window
content: Extended heat in late July could trim corn yields if rainfall disappoints; soybeans less exposed.

title: Indian monsoon progress near normal
content: Timely monsoon advance supports kharif sowing of rice, soybeans and cotton.

title: Australian wheat belt receives timely rains
content: Western Australia and New South Wales saw planting-season rainfall, improving yield prospects.

title: Regenerative agriculture acreage expands under grower programs
content: Cover cropping and reduced tillage enrolments rose sharply, supported by per-acre incentive payments.

title: EU deforestation regulation timelines clarified
content: Traceability requirements for soy and palm imports shape sourcing and documentation for exporters.

title: Low-carbon-intensity corn programs gain ethanol plant uptake
content: Carbon-scored feedstock premiums reward growers for reduced nitrogen and tillage.

title: Scope 3 reporting drives supply-chain data demand
content: Food manufacturers request farm-level emissions data from ingredient suppliers.

title: China soybean purchases shift toward Brazil
content: Tariff uncertainty and Brazilian price discounts increased Brazil's share of Chinese imports.

title: Indonesia palm oil export levy adjusted
content: Revised levy structure alters palm's competitiveness against soybean and sunflower oils.

title: Mexico GM corn import rules under review
content: Outcome of the USMCA panel affects US yellow corn export flows to Mexico.

title: EU tariffs on Russian grain imports take effect
content: Prohibitive duties redirect Russian wheat and oilseed flows toward MENA and Asia.

title: Funds extend net short in CBOT corn
content: Managed money added to short positions ahead of the acreage report, raising short-covering risk.

title: Soybean oil share of crush value hits multi-year high
content: Biofuel demand keeps oil share elevated relative to meal; crushers favour high-oil beans.

title: Cocoa volatility spills into sweet-goods formulation
content: Record cocoa prices push confectioners toward cocoa-butter equivalents and reduced-cocoa recipes.

title: Sugar futures fall on Brazil Centre-South output
content: Strong cane crush and higher sugar mix pressured raw sugar prices.

title: Palm oil stocks build in Malaysia
content: Seasonal production increase and slower exports lifted end-month inventories.

title: Predictive maintenance cuts unplanned downtime at crush plants
content: Vibration analytics on extractors reduced unscheduled stops across the pilot sites.

title: Grain elevator throughput improves with automated sampling
content: Automated probe and grading reduced truck turnaround at harvest peaks.

title: Energy efficiency upgrades lower dryer costs
content: Heat recovery on grain dryers cut natural gas use per bushel.

title: Digital grower platform adoption rises
content: More growers contract and price grain through the mobile app, smoothing origination flows.
